problems.problem: The left column still reads as a duplicated wordmark: logo 'Chloé' (bbox x90-171, y560-577, 24px) and title 'Chloé' (bbox x86-188, y700-728, 40px) are the same word at nearly the same width, stacked 123px apart. Visually (poster image 1) this is one word printed twice, not brand-mark-over-title; the brief's 'tailor's label' large-type title never appears because the only title string is the brand name again. text_product_overlap is false, so this is a hierarchy fault, not a collision.

Subtitle and price are empty strings, so the promised narrow editorial column occupies only ~102px of the 1080px canvas (<10% width) and stops at y=728, floating in empty linen roughly 300px above the bottle's visual mass (bottle spans y562-1224). Against references 3-5, whose type blocks are scaled to anchor the frame, this type cluster is under-scaled and disconnected.

The 2px linen-brown seam rule at (300,830) is nearly invisible against the #d9c09a cloth and sits in the gap between the type cluster (ends y728) and nothing below; the brief's full-height 'stitch' separating the two columns is not delivered, so the two-column editorial grid reads as an accident of margin rather than an intentional structure.

References 3-5 fuse product, light and type into one resolved image (cast shadow as a compositional line, props echoing the bottle, type scaled to the frame). Here the cutout is faithful and the contact shadow is correct (confirmed in the base crop), but the micro-type and invisible rule remain pasted-on marks; the design-quality gap to the references is still obvious despite the improved linen cyclorama.
